items.author: danielrosehill
items.description:
ASR Paragraph Breaks
	

Hand-annotated paragraph breaks for flat speech-to-text output. ASR engines emit punctuated, cased text
as one block. This dataset pairs that block (text) with the same text split into paragraphs by a person
(paragraphed). Nothing else changes: words, punctuation and casing are identical, and the annotation tool
refuses any save that alters them. It is training data for a small text-in/text-out model that does only
this one job.
Paragraphing is a judgement… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/danielrosehill/ASR-Paragraph-Breaks.

items.author: roneneldan
items.description:
Dataset containing synthetically generated (by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) short stories that only use a small vocabulary.
Described in the following paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.07759. 
The models referred to in the paper were trained on TinyStories-train.txt  (the file tinystories-valid.txt can be used for validation loss). These models can be found on Huggingface, at roneneldan/TinyStories-1M/3M/8M/28M/33M/1Layer-21M.
